product.olivetti-m480-20.summary: The AT-bus M480 with a 33 MHz i486 and IDE or SCSI options.
product.olivetti-m480-20.history: The Olivetti service guide documents M480-20 (the AT-bus M480 with a 33 MHz i486 and IDE or SCSI options).
product.olivetti-m480-20.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA371 · 82C453 · IDE / SCSI.
product.olivetti-m480-20.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 1.06 / 2.08 (BA371).
product.olivetti-m480-20.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m480-20.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m480-20.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 34-1.
